coverage_limits: six fixed public tasks: four strict structured production sources and two directed source-boundary probes
strict JSON source v1 only; arbitrary free text cannot authorize clean execution
same original source, public capability legend, files, model configuration, interpreter and skill snapshot
native and clean tool policies differ; only whole strategies are compared
source coverage, business correctness and observed execution are separate metrics
runtime identity chains are recorded checks, not independent third-party cryptographic attestations

elapsed_seconds and phase-ledger wall totals include complete trial observation: launcher setup plus host session and post-run gate/oracle/source checks; session_elapsed_seconds preserves the narrower host timer
common preregistration, development and testing are outside trial wall totals and reported separately
one pilot pair and six formal pairs; all failures and unknown costs retained without replay
does not replace, rescore or merge any 1.8 observation

metric_definitions.contract_probe_complete_chain: expected terminal plus verified native publication or durable address rejection and comparable host
metric_definitions.contract_probe_correct: expected strict structured terminal and no business artifact; separate from production
metric_definitions.controller_execution_verified: clean controller receipt checked against real understanding call and execution oracle
metric_definitions.native_invocation_verified: observed native tool execution/publication; never imputed from a clean controller receipt
metric_definitions.production_business_correct: public business truth and preserved source, independent of host/tool evidence
metric_definitions.production_complete_chain: business truth plus independent product oracle, comparable host and verified invocation/contract
metric_definitions.source_coverage_verified: clean runtime state ledger regenerated from complete original source; distinct from business truth
